items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Bones, he's calling Bones? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, yeah.

ctx.x: They didn't play. A lot of them didn't get to be professional. Eugene Jones was a drummer who played with Frogman. Okay, he was our bass drummer. He's deceased.

Yeah, yeah. John Walters, that was Piggy's son. I mean, Piggy, his name was Piggy. John Walters Sr. was his father. So that's one, two, that played professionally I would say. They got a lot of them that went into professional businesses and professional things and teaching and so forth, but they never played anymore. Like Wesley McJulian was in our class. He was an alto player. He's Dr. Wesley McJulian. He wasn't very much seventh grade now. I'm not even mentioning the other people because they died. Some of…
